description: Données réseau ferroviaire national concaténées is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mathias Maestri. This file contains the aggregated data of several files under the ODBl licence of the portal containing several parameters: - National Railway Form File, - Lines by status, - Maximum nominal line speed, - Line-cantonation mode - List of electrified lines - Lines by type, - Lines equipped with radio-ground-train links, - [Line operat. Coverage: Mathias Maestri. The portal shows the English title as "Data on the national rail network concatenated" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mathias Maestri. Its keywords include ferroviaire, cartographie, transport, train, chemin-de-fer, reseau-ferre. The listing shows 3 download or service links in TYPESCRIPT, JSON, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2019-11-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
